zh.title: 國防部偵獲中共17機艦船持續在台海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部指出，自7月31日上午6時至8月1日上午6時，共偵獲中共5架次軍機、10艘軍艦及2艘公務船持續在台海周邊活動。其中進入台灣西南及東部空域的軍機包括4架次輔戰機、直升機與無人機，以及1架東部直升機。國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部8月1日表示，自7月31日上午6時至8月1日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲中共軍機5架次、軍艦10艘次及公務船2艘，總計17機艦船持續在台海周邊活動。其中進入西南及東部空域的中共軍機計有5架次。
依據國防部公布的活動示意圖，國軍於7月31日中午12時15分至晚間9時10分，在海峽中線以東的台灣西南空域偵獲中共輔戰機、直升機及無人機共4架次；另於當日上午9時30分至11時在台灣東部空域偵獲1架中共直升機。國防部指出，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 17 Chinese Aircraft and Vessels Around Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated that between 06:00 on July 31 and 06:00 on August 1, a total of 17 Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels, and official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait. The detected assets included five aircraft entering Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace, ten naval vessels, and two official ships. According to the defense ministry, four auxiliary aircraft, helicopters, and drones were tracked in the southwestern airspace, while one helicopter was detected in eastern airspace. Taiwan's military monitored the activities using mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 1 that 17 Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels, and official ships were detected around the Taiwan Strait from 06:00 on July 31 to 06:00 on August 1. The total included five aircraft entering Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace, along with ten naval vessels and two official ships.

According to the defense ministry, four Chinese auxiliary aircraft, helicopters, and unmanned aerial vehicles were tracked in the southwestern airspace east of the median line between 12:15 and 21:10 on July 31. Additionally, one Chinese helicopter was detected in eastern airspace between 09:30 and 11:00 on July 31. Taiwan's military responded by deploying mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to monitor the situation.
